items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: His brothers, Simon, what we call him, Simon Moreira, and Eddie. He played with you too? Well, no. He was in a different band.

ctx.x: Did you ever know a fellow that played sousaphone named Booker? I know of him too, but I don't know him, Booker.

Booker Washington? Yeah, I don't know him. I know of him. What about Lawrence Muriero? Do you know him? Lawrence Muriero, I know him good as a book. He used to be a banjo player. He played with me. He did? In the Nola band? Yeah. Yeah, he played with the Nola band. Did you play with any of his relations too? Yeah. His brothers, Simon, what we call him, Simon Moreira, and Eddie. He played with you too? Well, no. He was in a different band. And John? John, yeah. John was with, for a long time he was with Tuxedo.…
I think he died about 1943. Oh, he was pretty good while ago.
